items.question: Who is Briana Butler?
items.answer: Briana Renee Gilbreath-Butler is an American former professional basketball guard who played for the Phoenix Mercury, Connecticut Sun, and Indiana Fever of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA).

items.question: What team does Briana Butler play for?
items.answer: Her most recent WNBA team on record is the Phoenix Mercury. Her listed position is Guard.
